decisions.reason: Changing the fiat on-ramp provider from Stripe to Coinbase Commerce does not change fiat users' email-based access to referrals, tickets, or prizes.
The provider change concerns the fiat payment path and does not modify the primary NFT mint behavior itself.
The source replaces Stripe with Coinbase Commerce for the fiat on-ramp but does not change Brevo as the email provider.
The fiat payment-provider replacement does not alter SIWE authentication for crypto mint and transfer flows.
The source does not change email or magic-link dashboard authentication for fiat and non-wallet users.
Secondary-sale royalty funding and ticket rules are independent of the selected fiat on-ramp provider.
Changing the fiat on-ramp provider does not alter which reward data the dashboard must display.
The provider replacement does not change unauthenticated access to public APIs.
The source does not change the automatic $5 commission for code-based referral mints.
Replacing the fiat on-ramp provider does not change the requirement to deploy the smart-contract system on Base.
